note: Product-free template renders of the Cuvette bottle; a product is composited from data at runtime. Made by scripts/cuvette/blender (sequence.py, render.py, pack_lean.py).

files.base: RGB lossy WebP or AVIF, tone-coded per channel: every serum absorbing all light, no print
files.light: greyscale lossy WebP or AVIF atlas of tone/depth-coded tiles (read .r); tiles sit on 16 px blocks with a 16 px gutter
files.data: RGB lossless WebP atlas; read with texelFetch only (never filter across split bytes)
files.tiles: each tile is a rect-sized cut of the full frame: atlas texel = tile.xy + (frame pixel - rect.xy); outside rect every plane is 0

tone.note: 8-bit display-matched code for light values: linear = table[byte]

encoding.u.hi/u.lo, v.hi/v.lo: 16-bit (hi * 256 + lo) / 65535: u around the print's arc, v up it, 0..1; all four bytes 0 = no coordinates
encoding.cov: byte / 255: how much of the pixel is print (occlusion and silhouette included)
encoding.nv: byte / 255: how squarely the print faces the lens
encoding.light.k: tone: neutral light that crossed bottle k's serum, caustics on the stone included; add light * exp(-sigma * depth)

depth.k.note: optical path through bottle k's serum in scene units (26 mm): max * (byte / 255)^2

encoding.shade: tone: light falling on the print area (multiply the ink's albedo)
encoding.front: tone: the glass's front-surface reflection over the print, to put back on top of the ink

coc.note: circle of confusion diameter in 1x pixels = byte * perByte (lens shots only)

owner.note: bottle 1..3 = round(byte / step); without a coc/owner tile every pixel is bottle 1

compact.note: item.crop = [x, y, w, h] of the wide frame that compact/{frame} holds; light/data are shared and in wide-frame pixels

sequence.camera: the live wide chapter path at 16:10, vertical fov, no depth of field

fromSequence.note: composite that sequence frame (wide), then cut `crop` (in 1600x1000 frame pixels; scale by size)
